title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Lucciana Perez Alarcon and Barbara Gatica in the W75 Florianópolis, Main Draw, originally scheduled for November 26, 2026 at 9:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Lucciana Perez Alarcon' if Lucciana Perez Alarcon advances against Barbara Gatica.

This market will resolve to 'Barbara Gatica' if Barbara Gatica advances against Lucciana Perez Alarcon.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 10, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
